title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 1: news of Jerusalem's broken wall reaches Susa, and Nehemiah prays.

questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:1 calls him Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah.

questions.text: Where was Nehemiah in the month Chislev of the twentieth year?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:1 says he was in Susa the palace.

questions.text: Who came to Nehemiah with certain men out of Judah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:2 says Hanani, one of his brothers, came with certain men out of Judah.

answers.text: Asaph the keeper of the forest

questions.text: What did the men report about the wall and gates of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:3 says the wall was broken down and its gates were burned with fire.

answers.text: The wall had just been finished
The gates had been covered with gold
The wall was guarded by the king's army
The wall was broken down and the gates burned

questions.text: What did Nehemiah do when he heard these words?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:4 says he sat down and wept, mourned several days, and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.

answers.text: He wept, mourned, fasted and prayed
He went to Jerusalem the same day
He wrote a letter to the governors
He gathered an army to fight

questions.text: With whom does God keep covenant and loving kindness, according to Nehemiah's prayer?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:5 says God keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments.

answers.text: All the kings of the earth
Those who love him and keep his commandments
Those who bring the most offerings

questions.text: Whom does Nehemiah include when he confesses sin?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:6 says, "Yes, I and my father's house have sinned."

questions.text: What had God said would happen if the people trespassed?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:8 recalls God's word to Moses: "If you trespass, I will scatter you among the peoples."

answers.text: He would take away their king
He would scatter them among the peoples
He would close the gates of heaven

questions.text: What had God promised to do if the people returned to him?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:9 says he would gather them, even from the uttermost part of the heavens, and bring them to the place he had chosen.

answers.text: Gather them to the place he had chosen
Give them a new land across the sea
Destroy all their enemies at once

questions.explanation: Nehemiah 1:11 ends: "Now I was cup bearer to the king."
